dread_whisper.name: Whisper of Dread
dread_whisper.linePt: The cultist chants low — the liturgy seeks cracks in your courage.

frost_lash.name: Frost Lash
frost_lash.linePt: The incense freezes in the air — the frost hunts your blood.

granite_slam.name: Granite Slam
granite_slam.linePt: The guardian raises a stone arm — the whole hall seems to weigh on the blow.

seismic_wave.name: Seismic Wave
seismic_wave.linePt: The colossus strikes the floor — stone ripples like water held still too long.

bone_needles.name: Bone Needles
bone_needles.linePt: Morvayn opens his hand — bone shards spin and point at you.

dread_liturgy.name: Liturgy of Dread
dread_liturgy.linePt: The necromancer's voice drops an octave; the dead listen with you.

throne_grasp.name: Throne Grasp
throne_grasp.linePt: Bones burst from the dais and seize — the throne fights too.

marrow_curse.name: Marrow Curse
marrow_curse.linePt: Morvayn whispers to the bone inside you — and the bone answers.

fallen_angel.name: Fallen Angel, Voice of the Veil

veil_verdict.name: Veil Verdict
veil_verdict.linePt: The severed wings unfold — what light remains becomes sentence.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.linePt: The hunter locks on the wounded — the Vigil does not waste arrows.

gray_focus.name: Grey Focus
gray_focus.linePt: Kael breathes deep and reads your guard like a fresh trail.

gray_focus.name: Grey Focus
gray_focus.linePt: Kael breathes deep and reads your guard like a fresh trail.

tracker_lunge.name: Tracker's Lunge
tracker_lunge.linePt: Grey steel closes the distance in a single step.

gray_focus.name: Grey Focus
gray_focus.linePt: Kael breathes deep and reads your guard like a fresh trail.

tracker_lunge.name: Tracker's Lunge
tracker_lunge.linePt: Grey steel closes the distance in a single step.

glacial_cleave.name: Glacial Cleave
glacial_cleave.linePt: The axe sweeps wide — frost follows the edge.

frost_breath.name: Frost Breath
frost_breath.linePt: Vetrnax inhales — the air around you surrenders first.

wind_shear.name: Wind Shear
wind_shear.linePt: The wings beat once; the wind cuts what will not bow.

deep_freeze.name: Deep Freeze
deep_freeze.linePt: The frozen heart pulses — deep cold does not scream; it occupies.

avalanche_wing.name: Avalanche Wing
avalanche_wing.linePt: Snow and thunder in the same wingbeat.

hymn_of_ruin.name: Hymn of Ruin
hymn_of_ruin.linePt: The broken choir sings backwards — each note steals ground.

shattered_verdict.name: Shattered Verdict
shattered_verdict.linePt: Fragments of the pantheon converge in a single pointing finger.

unveiling.name: Unveiling
unveiling.linePt: The herald pulls an invisible seam — reality groans where you stand.

seam_dread.name: Dread of the Seams
seam_dread.linePt: For an instant, everyone sees the invisible walls of their own certainty.

chorus_of_you.name: Chorus of You
chorus_of_you.linePt: The chorus repeats your words — in the tone you swore you never used.

dissonant_echo.name: Dissonant Echo
dissonant_echo.linePt: A wrong note, tuned on purpose, crosses your temple.

penitent_vice.name: Penitent's Vice
penitent_vice.linePt: The blade descends slowly — penance is never in a hurry.

sovereign_poise.name: Sovereign Poise
sovereign_poise.linePt: The reflection adjusts its stance — yours, without hesitation.

mirror_edge.name: Mirror's Edge
mirror_edge.linePt: The blow comes from the exact angle you would strike.

guiltless_verdict.name: Guiltless Verdict
guiltless_verdict.linePt: The reflection decides for you — and the decision hurts.

binding_clause.name: Binding Clause
binding_clause.linePt: The pen scores the air — the text demands your signature, still.

murmur_swell.name: Murmur Swell
murmur_swell.linePt: Mouths open at once — none of them says your name right.

chain_bind.name: Chain Bind
chain_bind.linePt: The chain sings and seeks a pulse — the link learns your weight.

crown_of_shards.name: Crown of Shards
crown_of_shards.linePt: The crown spins — each shard picks a face to reflect and cut.

regent_composure.name: Regent's Composure
regent_composure.linePt: The regent straightens the broken throne beneath them.

stain_sermon.name: Stain Sermon
stain_sermon.linePt: The preacher reads aloud — and the stain on you answers the call.

magma_fist.name: Magma Fist
magma_fist.linePt: The fist falls like melted stone — the floor answers first.

slag_skin.name: Slag Skin
slag_skin.linePt: The slag hardens; the golem grows harder to crack.

cinder_bite.name: Cinder Bite
cinder_bite.linePt: The teeth leave charcoal in the flesh.

sulfur_veil.name: Sulfur Veil
sulfur_veil.linePt: The air yellows — the lungs learn the price.

ash_drift.name: Ash Drift
ash_drift.linePt: The wraith thins; the next blow comes from the side.

anvil_slam.name: Anvil Slam
anvil_slam.linePt: The anvil falls with him — the whole hall feels it.

temper_rage.name: Tempered Rage
temper_rage.linePt: The metal in him sings louder.

crucible_breath.name: Crucible Breath
crucible_breath.linePt: The lord breathes — the room becomes a furnace.

lava_crown.name: Lava Crown
lava_crown.linePt: The crown descends on you like a verdict.

stone_throne.name: Stone Throne
stone_throne.linePt: He settles into the heat — and the heat obeys.

rogue_mira.name: Mira, the Shadow
rogue_mira.lorePt: She calls it "stealing from the dark" — not looting, but taking from the night the right to lie about fear.

squire_tomas.name: Tomás, the Squire
squire_tomas.lorePt: He still carries the shield of a knight who fell before him. Duty became habit, then choice.

act1_surface_whisper_intel.name: Rumor That Pays
act1_surface_whisper_intel.description: In the city underworld you heard what matters: names, hours, routes — intelligence worth gold, without asking for a miracle.

act1_surface_whisper_taint.name: Laughter on the Tongue
act1_surface_whisper_taint.description: Something on the surface returned a laugh that was not yours; the echo stayed in your mouth like old metal, and the depths remembered your taste.

act3_cult_flight.name: Flight Under Hoods
act3_cult_flight.description: You ran from the ambush with the Third Bell at your neck: supply lost, the Vigil suspicious, and a shard of shadow added to corruption.

act3_well_truth.name: Truth in the Well
act3_well_truth.description: You saw the mirror trick: the reflection lied, the real path opened to the left. You know how to read traps that pretend to be clarity.

act3_well_snare.name: Deceiving Reflection
act3_well_snare.description: You believed what the well showed; the map lied. The next room holds the surprise you chose not to see in time.

act3_rune_tuned.name: Stone Rhythm Tamed
act3_rune_tuned.description: You tuned the pulse of the runes; for moments the tomb obeyed your attention, and thought rises cleaner.

act3_rune_jarred.name: Echo in the Runes
act3_rune_jarred.description: The runes' compass denied you; a dry shock in the tendons, steps half a beat late — the wall reminded you that rushing is not mastery.

act6_memory_kept.name: Memory Intact
act6_memory_kept.description: In the veil's judgment you chose not to bleed what you guard; the price was another, but the core stayed yours.

act6_memory_spoiled.name: Stained Memory
act6_memory_spoiled.description: You let the trial tear what you were; the memory came out contaminated — useful perhaps, but no longer innocent.

act6_shadow_faced.name: Shadow Faced
act6_shadow_faced.description: In the final mirror you did not flee the double; naming the reflection cost you, but you wrested presence from the void.

act6_veil_aligned.name: Veil Aligned
act6_veil_aligned.description: At the drumhead of the real you chose focus over flight; the world still lies, but you learned where it steps.

act6_veil_broken.name: Veil in Shards
act6_veil_broken.description: You preferred to shatter the curtain; the noise you let in filters poorly — you see too much or too little, but no longer as before.

act6_void_pact_mark.name: Mark of the Void Pact
act6_void_pact_mark.description: You claimed the Void's secret by name; signature without ink, but the narrative remembers who surrendered the last grain.

act6_will_direct.name: Will Forward
act6_will_direct.description: In the trial of will you cut in a straight line; little dance, much impact — your path did not ask permission.

act6_will_measured.name: Measured Will
act6_will_measured.description: You traded iron for calculation; clean duel, counted steps — victory that tastes of discipline, not luck.

act6_will_scattered.name: Will in Flight
act6_will_scattered.description: The horde split your concentration into shreds; you survived in dispersion — honor of one who crosses chaos without pretending order.

act7_bell_ate_promise.name: Promise Digested
act7_bell_ate_promise.description: The silent bell offered a pact in whisper; you chose to swallow the promise — taste of a future you do not describe in words.

act7_bell_paid_faith.name: Bell Paid in Faith
act7_bell_paid_faith.description: You paid the bell with what cannot be weighed; the clapper changed owners and you kept the echo in conscience.

act7_broke_hollow_line.name: Hollow Line Broken
act7_broke_hollow_line.description: You broke the armed void formation; what was wall became breach — witness of one who did not yield to the parade.

act7_cinder_burned.name: Mark of Ash
act7_cinder_burned.description: The ash tithe demanded more than you gave; you burned in refusal or failure — skin remembers the furnace that measured you.

act7_cinder_favored.name: Favored by Ash
act7_cinder_favored.description: The tithe accepted your tribute; favored by the consuming current — not a clean blessing, recognition of one who pays.

act7_ember_witness.name: Witness of the Brazier
act7_ember_witness.description: You followed the brazier-devourer where the narrative burns; you witnessed the end without turning to ash — fright that stays on the retina.

act7_heard_ash_sermon.name: Ash Sermon
act7_heard_ash_sermon.description: You heard the verses of the last ash preacher; the homily does not ask amen, it asks silence — and you kept both.

act7_last_train_rider.name: Last Train
act7_last_train_rider.description: You boarded the rumor of the last train; passenger on a line that does not exist on the map — arrival where the calendar gives up.

act7_paid_sky_in_faith.name: Sky Paid in Faith
act7_paid_sky_in_faith.description: Before the final horizon you offered conviction to the lying ceiling; the sky kept the debt and you the scratch of the trade.

act7_sealed_in_ember.name: Sealed in the Brazier
act7_sealed_in_ember.description: You chose to close the cycle in heat that does not forgive; seal of embers — less word, more living scar.

act7_sky_stitch_torn.name: Sky Stitch Torn
act7_sky_stitch_torn.description: The stitch failed; the fabric of the firmament slipped between your fingers — shame of one who tried to mend the impossible and heard the tear.

act7_sky_stitch_true.name: True Stitch
act7_sky_stitch_true.description: You pulled the thread until it obeyed; the sky did not become perfect, but stopped bleeding on that front — craft of one who did not quit.

act7_walked_bare.name: Bare Step
act7_walked_bare.description: You refused narrative armor before the end; you walked bare of metaphors — exposure that is courage or madness, and perhaps both.

calvario_sealed.name: Dungeon Sealed
calvario_sealed.description: You carried the seal's weight in you; the depths fall silent — silence of stone — because you assumed the cost in faith and scar, instead of borrowing the rumor.

fled_rats.name: Retreat from the Rats
fled_rats.description: You chose not to measure strength against the tide of teeth; you survived at the cost of pride — whoever flees today tells the story tomorrow.

act2_brazier_scar.name: Brazier Scar
act2_brazier_scar.description: You tore the hot seal for provisions and left faith in the wax. Proof that survival also charges devotion.

mira_camp_shadows.name: Shadows with Mira
mira_camp_shadows.description: At camp Mira shared what she hides under laughter; trust of one who sees in the dark without asking for a lantern.

mira_cruzeiro_confidencia.name: Confession at the Crossroads
mira_cruzeiro_confidencia.description: You traded weak truths at the hub; she keeps a place on your emotional map that the stone map does not have.

mira_frost_pact.name: Frost Pact
mira_frost_pact.description: On the ice Mira bound word with you; promise that freezes before it leaves — loyalty that does not melt at the first sun.

mira_void_endtalk.name: Last Talk in the Void
mira_void_endtalk.description: At the arc's end she spoke as one who had already said goodbye to the body; you kept the sentence that does not fit in inventory.

monk_inner_peace.name: Inner Peace
monk_inner_peace.description: In the snow above the storm, a faceless monk left you a silence that asks no name — closure, not promise; the chest learned to breathe without trickery.

morvayn_slain.name: Morvayn Slain
morvayn_slain.description: Iron on the throne; Morvayn fell by your hand. You carry the dirty cleanup of one who kills to silence a name too loud.

pact_bound.name: Pact of the Third Bell
pact_bound.description: You signed silence on skin; the Cult inscribed itself in corruption that rises like interest on what you asked in the city's name.

soul_scarred_by_seal.name: Soul Scar of the Seal
soul_scarred_by_seal.description: The seal broke badly; the soul kept the stitching showing. Who fights with you notices the echo that does not close.

title_fallen_god.name: Title: Fallen God
title_fallen_god.description: You witnessed or consumed the title the summit denies; name that weighs like a crown of black stone — glory and curse at once.

tomas_camp_oath.name: Oath with Tomás
tomas_camp_oath.description: By camp fire the squire bound word with you; mutual duty that smells of iron and broken bread.

tomas_void_duty.name: Duty in the Void
tomas_void_duty.description: In the final desert Tomás named obligation without fanfare; you carry duty that asks no applause, only fulfillment.

vetrnax_slain.name: Vetrnax Slain
vetrnax_slain.description: The ice lost its titan; the range remembers who closed the name in snow with blade or ritual.

magma_lord_slain.name: Magma Lord Slain
magma_lord_slain.description: The floor of the axis lost its lord; the crucible still burns, but without will — silence finally has a floor.

wound_mire_leg.name: Mire Bite
wound_mire_leg.description: Luck failed in the mire; the leg remembers teeth that are not yours — rudder that lags a second when danger demands two.

act1_wall_memory.name: Wall memory
act1_wall_memory.description: You touched stone that felt like fossilized flesh; your arm remembers the shiver — the dungeon touches back.

act1_mirror_shard.name: Shard on the step
act1_mirror_shard.description: You saw yourself in a mirror shard: a stranger with your name. The reflection does not absolve the next step.

act1_entrance_mirror.name: Broken niche
act1_entrance_mirror.description: Half your face, half the tunnel — the same cut. The glass demanded a choice before silence chose for you.

act1_hand_mirror.name: Hand mirror
act1_hand_mirror.description: You held the mirror without the water lying; only you and your promises — no cheap absolution.

act1_door_runes.name: Doorframe runes
act1_door_runes.description: You read re-scored runes and the crude Third Bell; the wood damp inside still breathes.

act2_rats_listen.name: Counted squeaks
act2_rats_listen.description: You heard the swarm in pattern — almost language. You counted steps before advancing.

act2_rats_smell.name: Nest stench
act2_rats_smell.description: Mold, iron, and hot copper: old blood that never fully dried. Your nose paid the price.

act2_cruzeiro_marks.name: Crossroads marks
act2_cruzeiro_marks.description: Three furrows, footprints turning back, Morvayn and a driven bell — the floor as a map of those who quit halfway.

throne.name: Morvayn's Throne
throne.description: What you did at the throne sets the tone of the ice — and of what descends after.

slain.name: Iron on the Throne
slain.description: Morvayn fell to steel. The axis stays open; victory is thin and the cold does not absolve.

pact.name: Bell Pact
pact.description: The Third Bell wrote itself into your skin. Corruption is the interest; the world learns to hush when you breathe.

sealed.name: Calvary Seal
sealed.description: You sealed the hole in faith. The underworld goes quiet because you carried the weight — scars on the soul, fragile peace in stone.

cleric.name: Devout Pulse
cleric.description: At the start of your turn, regenerate 1% of max HP (rounded up).

mage.name: Arcane Thread
mage.description: At the start of your turn, regenerate 1% of max mana (rounded up).

monk_inner_peace.name: Inner Peace
monk_inner_peace.description: +1 permanent LCK — blessing of the snow monk: luck as discipline, not trickery.
